description: Searches active inventory in the authenticated workspace and can identify low-stock items without exposing internal cost or margin fields. Use to search inventory in the connected business. Returns query, count, total, inventory, filters, scope.

active.description: Filter by active state; defaults to true.

low_stock.description: Only items at or below minimum quantity.

name: search-inventory

filters.description: Filters metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

inventory.description: Bounded inventory records returned by this tool.

query.description: Query used or returned by this tool.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

title: Search Inventory Tool
